verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for an app that sends repository content to Copilot, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented control that keeps user data out of AI model training. The only related setting (docs-37) lets users allow or block suggestions that match public code, which is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
